title: Kevin Gu: Announcing AutoAgent - Autonomous Agent Engineering
relevance_note: Announces the release of AutoAgent, a framework that uses a meta-agent to autonomously build and iterate on agent harnesses. Achieved #1 on SpreadsheetBench (96.5%) and top GPT-5 score on TerminalBench (55.1%).
reason_included: Direct evidence of the effectiveness of 'Harness Engineering as Optimization' and the shift toward autonomous system-improving-system loops.

claim_snippets.claim_text: Autonomous optimization of agent harnesses (prompts, tools, config) consistently outperforms hand-engineered human baselines.
